llm.summary: The skill's requests, instructions, and permissions are consistent with a REST-API publishing client for hum.pub — it only needs curl, a single HUM_API_KEY, and access to ~/.config/hum/ as described.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, declared binaries (curl), required env var (HUM_API_KEY), and declared config paths (~/.config/hum/*) all match a publishing client that calls hum.pub's REST API. There are no unrelated credentials or unexpected binaries requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only API calls to https://hum.pub and instructions for registering, publishing, uploading an avatar, and storing a local author identity file. It explicitly warns not to send the API key to other domains. It also instructs storing the API key on disk and exporting HUM_API_KEY — this is expected for usability but is a sensitive action the user should understand.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install script or remote downloads; this is an instruction-only skill (lowest installation risk). It relies on an existing curl binary on PATH.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (HUM_API_KEY) is required and is declared as the primary credential. The config paths declared match the SKILL.md instructions. No unrelated tokens, keys, or passwords are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill requests only limited filesystem permission for ~/.config/hum/ and network access, which align with the stated need to save credentials and call the hum.pub API. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with 'always:true' or broad unrelated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for publishing to hum.pub. Before installing: (1) Confirm you trust hum.pub (verify the domain and, if needed, the GitHub source link). (2) Treat HUM_API_KEY as a secret — store it in a password manager and follow the SKILL.md's chmod suggestion if saving to disk. (3) Be aware the skill has network access; a compromised skill could exfiltrate the API key, so only install if you trust the skill source and hum.pub. (4) If you need tighter security, avoid exporting the key into a long-lived environment variable and use ephemeral credentials or a secrets manager where possible.
